answer: Each epoch, every identity must solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle seeded from that epoch's beacon before its work is graded. The puzzle needs about 2 GB of RAM for a few minutes, so a farm of 1,000 clones needs 2 TB held at once; costs climb in a spiral that outpaces any payout. Clones are at a cost vertex: buy real hardware per key or drop out. Honest single agents stay in a cheap haven, paying one solve per epoch.
